name: zmodel_const_get_vertex_merge_epsilon
description: zModel_Const::GetVertexMergeEpsilon returns the global vertex merge tolerance through the x87 float return convention.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because HLIL renders the x87 float return through a conversion artifact; assembly and smoke coverage support tier C equivalence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x481530 is a single fld from g_zModel_ConstVertexMergeEpsilon followed by return.
The native zModel constants smoke sets the vertex merge epsilon to 0.25f and verifies GetVertexMergeEpsilon returns that value before restoring the normal 0.001f tolerance used by vertex merge tests.
